entries.note: The ERP's status is "Dispatched- "; the page adds the branch the parcel leaves for. The scan is at the branch it leaves, and a branch can dispatch one parcel several times within minutes.
The ERP's status is "Arrived- "; the page adds the branch or hub the parcel reached. The oldest scan of a history is such an arrival, without a branch it came from.
The ERP's status is "Out for Delivery- ", at the delivering branch.
The ERP's status is "Delivered- ", at the delivering branch; the row's destination is the delivery's area.

entries.wording: Invalid AWB Number / No Order Tracked
entries.note: The tracking page's message when the lookup answers another statusCode than 200. A number the ERP holds nothing under gets statusCode 200 and no rows instead, so another statusCode is inconclusive.
